purpose: Diagnostic observations for CI load planning. These failed or partial runs are not a performance baseline, test PASS receipt, or complete suite coverage proof.
method: Sum Bun-reported per-test durations under each executed file header. Stop before repeated failure summaries. Pass and failure duration are separate; process startup, module initialization, hooks and unfinished cases are not included.

loadPlanningPolicy.selection: Retain distinct executions with the highest observed passSeconds + failSeconds, at most two per path; this capture has one execution per path.
loadPlanningPolicy.observedLoad: passSeconds + failSeconds is observed failed-run load, not an estimate of healthy runtime.
loadPlanningPolicy.failures: Do not interpret failed durations or explicit/cooperative deadlines as typical successful cost. runnerReportedTimeoutTests counts only Bun's explicit timeout messages; other deadline failures remain in failSeconds.
loadPlanningPolicy.partial: Partial observations are lower bounds. An absent file or a zero completed-case duration is unknown, never zero execution cost.
loadPlanningPolicy.future: Re-measure the same source tree after runtime fixes before calling any estimate an improvement.
